# datagecko Provider

Manages datagecko streams, series, metrics, charts, sections, query panels, actions, runner hooks and ingest keys for one organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    datagecko = {
      source  = "funktionswerk/datagecko"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "datagecko" {
  # admin_key can also come from the DATAGECKO_ADMIN_KEY environment variable.
  admin_key = var.datagecko_admin_key
}

variable "datagecko_admin_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  default   = null
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `admin_key` (String, Sensitive) The organization's admin key. Falls back to the DATAGECKO_ADMIN_KEY environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the datagecko API. Defaults to https://datagecko.ai/api/v1/.
